_source: UniProt DISULFID feature annotations, text-format flatfiles fetched 2026-07-13 from https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/<ACC>.txt. Every bond pair below was grep-verified against the FT DISULFID lines and each Cys position was asserted against the sequence in analyze.py (seq[pos-1] == 'C').

_disulfide_count_verification.P08174_DAF-CD55: grep -c '^FT   DISULFID' -> 8 (all in SCR1-4 / Sushi 1-4, aa 35-285; 2 per sushi domain)
_disulfide_count_verification.P02788_lactoferrin: grep -c '^FT   DISULFID' -> 16 (bilobal transferrin fold; several very-long-range C-lobe bonds)

C1-INH.full_name: Plasma protease C1 inhibitor (SERPING1 / C1-INH), Homo sapiens
C1-INH.engineering_construct_note: Serpin-core, mucin-like O-glycan domain (aa 23-119) truncated per comp-037. Retains both disulfides + RCL R466-T467.
C1-INH.n_glyc_note: N-glycans drive plasma half-life (Bos 1998 PMID 9799502); NOT required for the serpin suicide-inhibitor mechanism, which is polypeptide-encoded. For a gut-luminal secreted format, plasma half-life is irrelevant.

DAF_SCR1-4.full_name: Complement decay-accelerating factor (CD55 / DAF), Homo sapiens, SCR1-4 truncation
DAF_SCR1-4.fold_architecture: CCP / SCR / sushi (4 compact ~60-aa beta-sandwich modules)
DAF_SCR1-4.engineering_construct_note: SCR1-4 only per comp-012. Ser/Thr GPI-linker stalk (aa 286-353) truncated. All 8 disulfides retained.
DAF_SCR1-4.n_glyc_note: Single N-glycan at N95 (SCR1). Decay-accelerating activity is a protein-protein interaction (SCR2-4 bind C3b/C4b); N95 glycan not required for function. O-glycans are on the truncated stalk.

lactoferrin.engineering_construct_note: Full mature bilobal protein. No stalk-truncation rescue available: the bilobal fold + 16-disulfide architecture is intrinsic to iron-binding function; there is no dispensable disordered appendage analogous to the CD55 stalk or C1-INH mucin domain.
lactoferrin.n_glyc_note: 3 N-glycans. Iron-binding + lactoferricin antimicrobial function are polypeptide-encoded; glycans aid protease resistance + thermal stability. Non-native (fungal) glycans tolerated (Sun 1999 PMID 10089347, A. awamori-produced hLf, native fold). EcN produces NO glycan at all.
